in_telugu.name: మల్తి
in_telugu.long_meaning: Garland of Lord Shiva and Parvathi

in_marathi.name: Malti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Nectar of immortality
in_marathi.long_meaning: Malti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'mālatī', meaning 'nectar of immortality' or 'giving life'. In Hindu mythology, Malti is the name of a woman who was transformed into a tree and provided the nectar of immortality to Shiva.
